close_reason: Rewrote jmap-metadata-types for draft-ietf-jmap-metadata-02. Deleted metadata.rs (old Metadata enum + Annotation/ImapMetadata/WebDavMetadata variants), backend.rs (MetadataProperty + JmapObject impls). Rewrote capability.rs (DataTypeMetadataInfo replaces MetadataCapability), filter.rs (MetadataTextMatch replaces MetadataFilterCondition). description:
Complete rewrite of jmap-metadata-types to align with draft-ietf-jmap-metadata-02.

**What changes:**
- DELETE: Metadata enum (Annotation/ImapMetadata/WebDavMetadata variants), MetadataProperty enum, MetadataFilterCondition (standalone), MetadataCapability (standalone shape), UniquenessKey, all associated round-trip tests
- ADD: MetadataValue type — the value shape inside namespace-keyed metadata/privateMetadata maps (§2.1-2.2: key is namespace identifier, value is server-defined object)
- ADD: DataTypeMetadataInfo struct (§2.3) — capability advertisement per opted-in type (metadataNamespaces: String[], privateMetadataNamespaces: String[], metadataMaxSize: UnsignedInt|null, privateMetadataMaxSize: UnsignedInt|null)
- ADD: MetadataTextMatch struct — filter helper for the 6 new filter conditions (metadataExists, privateMetadataExists, metadataTextContains, privateMetadataTextContains, metadataTextEquals, privateMetadataTextEquals)
- ADD: Namespace validation helpers — registered names (no dot, IANA registry) vs vendor domain names (contains dot)
- KEEP: JMAP_METADATA_URI capability constant (urn:ietf:params:jmap:metadata unchanged between revisions)
- KEEP: Crate exists as a type-only crate with serde + jmap-types deps

**Spec reference:** draft-ietf-jmap-metadata-02 §2 (Metadata Properties), §2.3 (DataTypeMetadataInfo), §3.1 (Metadata Capability)

**Wire format:** metadata and privateMetadata are Id[Object] maps keyed by namespace identifier. The Object shape is intentionally opaque (server-defined per namespace). MetadataValue can be serde_json::Value or a thin newtype.
title: Rewrite jmap-metadata-types for -02 architecture
